concerns.text: FR-003 requires a left‑censored 30‑day moving average for anomaly calculation, but the plan implements a 60‑day left‑censored baseline (Phase 1). The baseline length does not match the specification.

FR-004 mandates a 7‑day block‑permutation scheme for the permutation test. The plan only mentions a generic 10 000‑shuffle permutation test without specifying block‑permutation, leaving the requirement unaddressed.
SC-001 specifies detecting Cohen’s d ≥ 0.3 with p < 0.05 in ≥ 80 % of 1 000 bootstrap resamples. The plan contains no bootstrap resampling procedure nor any mention of this success criterion.

SC-004 requires the full analysis to complete within 4 hours on a standard CPU‑only GitHub Actions runner. The plan does not provide any runtime budget, performance testing, or assurance that the pipeline meets this constraint.

SC-002 expects measurement of robustness via consistency of p‑values across regions and magnitude thresholds. While the plan includes stratified analyses, it does not explicitly state how consistency will be quantified or reported, leaving the success criterion ambiguous.
